Education Minister Pradhan Resigns Amid Protests, Joshi Takes Over

Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned as Union Education Minister, with Pralhad Joshi appointed to ensure continuity. The resignation follows protests, with some outlets reporting it was not voluntary and was prompted by student actions. The daughter of Odisha BJP MP Aparajita Sarangi reportedly posted in support of protesters, sparking internal party ire and leading to her Instagram account being deactivated after online trolling. Separately, a social media influencer was booked for an abusive reel against Pradhan.
